d.t: TURNING TOOL FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Turning Tool is an attachment that, when used with a power tool, attaches to the top of adjustable pedestals to easily and quickly adjust the height of the pedestal. SikaRoof VersiJack Turning Tool is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack pedestals, and helps to screw or unscrew the pedestals to adjust their heights at a faster pace for quicker installation times.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Turning tools are used with adjustable pedestals for raised flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
